Minimum Qualifications
• MSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a directly related field or equivalent demonstrated production experience in lieu of formal qualification

• Infrastructure-as-code practice applied comprehensively and without exception

Preferred Qualifications

• Background from Spotify infrastructure, Ericsson cloud, King platform engineering, or Einride

jobs.occupation: Souschef till vårt växtbaserade produktionskök i Stockholm
jobs.description:
Rebelly lagar tredagarsfastor som folk faktiskt längtar efter att äta. Allt tillagas från grunden i vårt eget produktionskök i Stockholm och levereras till kunder i hela Sverige. Menyn byts varje månad, vi tar fram nya produkter och vi jobbar med de bästa råvarorna vi kan hitta. Allt är alltid veganskt och glutenfritt, eftersom fastan följer en metod som bygger på forskning om fasta. Det är ramarna, och inom dem finns kreativiteten.
Nu söker vi en souschef som blir nummer två till vår kökschef.

OM ROLLEN
Du jobbar sida vid sida med kökschefen och driver köket när han inte är där. Du planerar och leder produktionsdagarna: ugnar, blästerkylar, preplistor och vem som gör vad. Du bygger recept och skalar dem från provsats till över 300 portioner utan att smaken ändras. Du håller egenkontrollen och HACCP i ordning varje vecka, och du bygger rutiner, listor och dokumentation som håller när vi växer.
Vi har ingen servering och ingen pass. Köket går i dag måndag till fredag, 08–16. När vi växer kan det bli fler skift.

VEM VI SÖKER
Det vi söker mest är ordning. Du är riktigt kunnig i köket, extremt ordningsam och jobbar kliniskt rent. Du vill jobba hårt och köra, du tar ansvar utan att någon behöver be dig, och du letar efter något långsiktigt.

Du har:
- erfarenhet som souschef, köksmästare eller i en annan ledande roll i kök
- kunskap om HACCP och egenkontroll i praktiken
- vana att bygga och skala recept, gärna från storkök, catering eller produktion
- god engelska (svenska är meriterande)
Meriterande: växtbaserad matlagning och storköksmetoder som GN-bleck, kombiugnar och blästerkyl.

VI ERBJUDER
En nyckelroll i ett bolag som växer snabbt. Planen är att Rebelly om några år finns på fler platser än Stockholm, och kökschefens nummer två är den som ligger närmast att driva köket på en ny plats när vi öppnar. Du blir en del av ett litet team där alla har samma mål: att bygga Rebelly.
Heltid, tillsvidare med sex månaders provanställning.
Lön: 30 000–35 000 kr i månaden beroende på erfarenhet.

SÅ SÖKER DU
Mejla ditt CV till join@rebelly.se och skriv "Souschef" i ämnesraden. Skriv i mejlet när du kan börja och ge ett kort exempel på en rutin eller ett system du har byggt i ett kök. Vi går igenom ansökningarna löpande och bjuder in till ett betalt provpass i köket, så vänta inte med att söka.
---
IN ENGLISH
Rebelly cooks three-day fasts that people actually look forward to eating. Everything is made from scratch in our own production kitchen in Stockholm and delivered to customers all over Sweden. The menu changes every month, we develop new products, and we work with the best raw ingredients we can find. Everything is always vegan and gluten-free, because the fast follows a method built on research on fasting. Those are the edges, and the creativity lives inside them.
We are now looking for a sous chef to become number two to our Head of Kitchen.

THE ROLE
You work side by side with the Head of Kitchen and run the kitchen when he is not there. You plan and lead the production days: ovens, blast chillers, prep lists, who does what and when. You build recipes and scale them from a test batch to more than 300 portions without the taste changing. You keep self-monitoring and HACCP in order every week, and you build routines, lists and records that hold as we grow.
There is no service and no pass. Today the kitchen runs Monday to Friday, 08:00 to 16:00. As we grow, there may be more shifts.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
What we need most is order. You are highly skilled in the kitchen, extremely orderly and you work clinically clean. You want to work hard and drive things forward, you take responsibility without being asked, and you are looking for something long-term.

You have:
- experience as a sous chef, head chef or in another leading kitchen role
- hands-on knowledge of HACCP and self-monitoring
- experience building and scaling recipes, ideally from large-scale kitchens, catering or production
- good English (Swedish is a plus)
A plus: plant-based cooking and large-scale methods such as gastronorm trays, combi ovens and blast chillers.

WHAT WE OFFER
A key role in a company that is growing fast. The plan is that Rebelly will be in more places than Stockholm within a few years, and the Head of Kitchen's number two is the natural person to run the kitchen in a new location when we open one. You join a small team where everyone shares one goal: to build Rebelly.
Full time, permanent with a six-month probation period.

Department of Biosystems and Technology
 
PhD project in Agricultural Science: Using agricultural crop biomass for biogas in synergy with the development of sustainable cropping systems
 
Note: This advertisement is abbreviated to fit in Platsbanken's recruitment tool. To view the ad in its entirety including additional information, please visit https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/jobs-and-vacancies/
 
About the position
Targeting the sustainable supply of agricultural crop biomass as substrates for biogas, the project will use a field experiment platform to investigate crop yields and crop nutrient dynamics in different scenarios for biomass removal and nutrient redistribution via digestates. The research will primarily be based on an ongoing long-term cropping systems experiment with four distinct systems: conventional, organic, agroforestry and perennial cereal.
The biomass resources to be studied include, but are not limited to: cover crops, ley, straw (from cereals, grain legumes and oilseed crops), beet leaves, and possibly wood. Studies on quantities and nutrient contents of different biomasses build on existing data from the experiment, to be complemented with additional sample collection and analyses as well as literature data or data from agricultural statistics databases.
 
The holder of this position will be a part of a national transdisciplinary center of excellence called Biogas Solutions Research Center (BSRC). Here, co-production of new and relevant knowledge is generated through collaboration between different scientific disciplines as well as between researchers and practitioners from industry and public organizations. The BSRC includes researchers and support from two universities, Linköping University and Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences, as well as about 50 private and public organizations involving all parts of the biogas system. It also has support from the Swedish Energy Agency.
 
All doctoral positions advertised within BSRC will be formulated so that they fit into the competence center's research plans and at the same time reflect our parties' interests. This way, we ensure long-term competence supply to both industry and academia.
 
Requirements
To meet the general entry requirements you must have been awarded a second-cycle (Master’s) qualification, satisfied the requirements for courses comprising at least 240 credits of which at least 60 credits were awarded in the second-cycle, or acquired substantially equivalent knowledge in some other way in Sweden or abroad (Higher Education Ordinance 1993:100, Chapter 7, Section 39).
 
You must also meet the equivalent English language requirements as those necessary for the Swedish upper-secondary qualification Engelska B/6.
 
You should have a Master’s degree, or equivalent qualification, in a relevant field such as agricultural engineering (with specialization in crop production), agricultural science, agroecology, agronomy, biology, environmental science, horticultural science or another closely related discipline.
 
Your profile
We are looking for a highly motivated candidate with an interest in sustainable agriculture and bioeconomy systems, and in analysing complex interactions between biomass and food production and cropping system sustainability.
 
Experience or documented knowledge in one or several of the following areas is particularly relevant:
agricultural cropping systems, crop management and diversification;
systems analysis and/or multi-criteria sustainability assessments;
modelling or scenario analysis;
bioenergy systems based on agricultural crop biomass resources;
nutrient cycling e.g. via redistribution of biomass resources and biogas digestates;
crop and soil nutrient dynamics and nutrient balances at field and cropping system levels;
statistical analysis and handling of datasets with multiple experimental factors and response variables

 
The project strives to provide knowledge for several societal sectors (bioenergy, food production, environmental impact), it is therefore important to have an ability to understand and integrate information from different scientific fields. The successful candidate should have good analytical skills, be able to work independently and systematically, and at the same time enjoy collaboration in an interdisciplinary research environment.
 
Excellent written and spoken English is required. Good communication skills and an interest in communicating research both scientifically and to stakeholders are important. Knowledge of Swedish is advantageous but not a requirement.
 
Personal qualities, motivation for doctoral studies and the ability to successfully complete the research project will be given considerable weight in the selection process.
